description: This file defines a React functional component named `Modal` used for rendering a flexible, accessible modal dialog overlay. It includes props to control visibility, content, styling, and behavior such as closing on Escape key press and backdrop click. The component manages dynamic positioning and styling, and uses React Portal to render the modal outside the main DOM hierarchy.
